I.A. No. 1 of 2023

In Re:
 CRA No. 211 of 2023 Gendlal Tekam, S/o Mohpal Tekam, aged about 51 Years, Caste - Gond, R/o Kukdadah Schoolpara, Police Station Keshkaal, District Kondagaon (C.G.)
 ---- Appellant  Versus State of Chhattisgarh, Through The Station House Incharge, Police Station Keshkaal, District Kondagaon (C.G.)

---- Respondent (Cause-title taken from Case Information System) 12/06/2024 Heard Mr. Hemant Kumar Agrawal,
learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Nitansh Jaiswal, learned Panel Lawyer, appearing for the State/respondent on the instant application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail (I.A. No. 1 of 2023).
It is stated that notice has been served upon the PW-5, mother of the victim.

By the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 18.11.2022, the Additional Sessions judge FTSC(POCSO), Kondagaon, District - Kondagaon (C.G.) in POCSO Case No. 67 of 2021 has convicted the appellant and sentenced as mentioned below :-
 Conviction Sentence  U/s 450 of IPC RI for 05 years and fine amount of Rs.1000/- in default of payment of fine RI for o1 month U/s 376 (3) of RI for life & fine of Rs.1000/-.

entities.text: Additional Sessions judge FTSC(POCSO), Kondagaon, District - Kondagaon (C.G.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: IPC U/s 376(2)() of RI for life & fine of Rs.1000/- in default of payment of fine RI for 01 month.
IPC U/s 506 of IPC RI for 02 years & fine of Rs.1000/- in default of payment of fine RI for o1 month U/s 6 of POCSO RI for life & fine of Rs.1000/- in default of Act payment of fine RI for 01 month.

All the sentences are directed to run concurrently It has been argued by learned counsel for the appellant that the age of the victim on the date of incident was 15 years 08 months and 11 days but it is a case of false implication.
DNA of the appellant was done and it was found to be negative and applicant was not found to be father of the child.
A suggestion has been given by the appellant that the prosecutrix was having relationship with one Umendra though the same has been denied by the prosectrix.

This might be doubtful that the applicant entered in the house of the prosecutrix at the Gendlal Tekam vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175070360/
1 presence of her family member.

sentences.text: Hence he prays that the appellant be enlarged on bail.

However, Mr.
Nitansh Jaiswal, learned Panel Lawyer for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the records.

Taking into account that DNA report found to be negative and also considering the evidence available particularly of victim (PW-1) and the appellant is in jail since 14.09.2021 and hearing of this appeal would take prolonged period of time, we deem it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant.
Accordingly, the substantive jail sentence awarded to appellant by the learned trial Court is hereby suspended.

The appellant - Gendlal Tekam shall be released on bail on his executing bail bond with one surety to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 06.08.2024.

He shall thereafter appear before the concerned trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given to him by the said Court, interval being not less than 6 months, till final disposal of this appeal.
Consequently, IA No. 1 of 2023 is allowed.

It is made clear that the observations made here-in-above are only confined for disposal of aforesaid IA filed in this appeal and it shall not be construed as an expression of opinion of this Court on the merits of the matter.
List this matter for final hearing.
C.C. as per rules.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Sachin Singh Rajput) (Ramesh Sinha)
 Judge Chief Justice  Sd/- Sd/-
